github.content:

Changelog: Feature: Allow applying patches on "create" time for conan-center-index like layouts from an external centralized folder.
Docs: https://github.com/conan-io/docs/pull/3965

Close https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/17360


Some constraints:
- Recipes must have ``export_conandata_patches()`` call
- Recipes must have the ``conandata.yml`` with a ``patches`` entry (otherwise ``export_conandata_patches`` fails anyway)
- It only works after a ``trim_conandata()``. If not it will most likely crash.

content: Fix: Fix Git is_dirty detection of excluded files with paths. [#17571](https://github.com/conan-io/conan/pull/17571)

github.content:
### GitHub Pull Request #17571 Updated to use maxsplit=1
Changelog: Fix: Fix `Git` `is_dirty` detection of excluded files with paths.
Docs: Omit


I have a file that has a space in its name. In the conan export method I use it like this:
```
def export(self):
        git = Git(self, self.recipe_folder, excluded=["src/file Component Toolchain.prj"])
        git.coordinates_to_conandata()
```
 and this fails because of the split:
```
lines = [line.split()[1] for line in lines if line]
```

Closes https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/17570

content: Fix: Error out when unknown language is used in languages attribute. [#17512](https://github.com/conan-io/conan/pull/17512)

github.content:
### GitHub Pull Request #17512 Guard against unknown languages attribute values
Changelog: Fix: Error out when unknown language is used in languages attribute.
Docs: Omit

This ensures only known languages are used - Helpful when typing lowercase versions or variants of C++ by mistake. In case of C for example, this would lead to the cppstd setting unexpectedly affecting the pkgid, for which there was no warn before this

The only drawback for this is that it eliminates potential custom usages of the attribute in user customizations, but those can be solved by using any other user-specific attribute if needed
